description: When each Walt Disney World ride's Lightning Lane sold out, measured by SupaPark. range "today": today's sellout times so far (or "still available"). range "week": the typical sellout time over the last seven complete days, with how many days sold out and how many were gone before 7:00 AM. Times are Eastern. Disneyland Resort parks (disneyland, california-adventure) are accepted but not covered here yet: they return quality_state "unavailable" with a reason (live Disneyland Resort waits: get_live_wait_times).

park.description: Filter to one park. Omit for all four parks.

resort.description: Resort: "wdw" (Walt Disney World, the default) or "dlr" (Disneyland Resort). A park argument, when given, decides the resort.

name: get_lightning_lane_sellouts
title: Lightning Lane sellout times
